title: Ballroom Year
about: Looking back on the ballroom-themed year as the beginning of memories and relationships that lasted far beyond the production.
description: This track remembers the Ballroom Year through the stage itself: the mansion, grand staircase, balcony, music, and constant movement through the show. The scenery was temporary and eventually disappeared, but the people and experiences attached to it remained. Looking back, the ballroom became more than a set; it became the setting for the beginning of a story that continued long after the lights went dark.

Lyrics: They called it the Ballroom Year,
A mansion built beneath the lights.
The set is what I see.
Long before I understood the plan.
The lights filled up the sky.
Funny how I remember the people
Long before I knew first love.
Because somewhere in those seven days,
Every time I close my eyes.
